title: Royal Midnight Chanderi Silk-Cotton Saree with Gold Ashrafi Zari
short_description: Handcrafted sheer Chanderi saree shimmering with traditional Ashrafi gold coin motifs woven painstakingly over 14 days on a pit loom.
detailed_story: The Ashrafi (gold coin) motif was historically patronized by the Scindia royals of Gwalior. Devendra Kumar Ansari spent two weeks carefully hand-manipulating the gold zari extra-weft shuttles across sheer 100s count cotton-silk warp. Breathable, featherlight, and possessing a regal sheen, this masterpiece directly rewards the artisan family with over 80% of retail earnings.
care_instructions: Dry clean recommended for first two washes; gentle cold wash thereafter with natural soapnut extract. Iron on silk setting.

title: Heirloom Kanchipuram Pure Mulberry Silk Saree with Temple Korvai Border
weft_yarn: Twisted Murukku Pattu Silk with Pure Silver-Gold Zari
dye_type: Acid-free Silk Certified Dyes with Turmeric mordant
short_description: Authentic Korvai interlocking weave Kanchipuram silk saree featuring double-warp heavy drape and pure zari temple (Gopuram) border.
detailed_story: Woven by master couple Meenakshi and Sundaram over 26 intensive loom days, this saree exemplifies the endangered Korvai interlocking technique where husband and wife operate opposite shuttles simultaneously. The interlocking seam between vermillion red body and deep temple green border is smooth and unbreakable. Heavy pure silk that softens across generations.
care_instructions: Dry clean only. Roll in muslin cloth to preserve silver-gilt zari brilliance.

title: Featherlight Jamdani Fine Muslin Cotton Dupatta with Floral Butis
weft_yarn: 100s Organic Cotton with Supplementary Bamboo Reed Weft
short_description: Sheer handloom Jamdani muslin dupatta with discontinuous floating weft floral motifs woven without any punch cards.
detailed_story: Bimal Basak weaves Jamdani by threading supplementary weft motifs individually with bamboo needles as the sheer ground cloth progresses. The muslin has a weightless, floating feel against the skin, ideal for tropical summers. Motifs represent wild jasmine flowers (Chomeli) flourishing on the banks of the Bhagirathi river.
care_instructions: Hand wash gently in cold water with mild mild detergent; shade dry.

title: Pochampally Double Ikat Silk Saree in Geometric Diamond Chevron
color: Charcoal Black, Ochre Yellow & Lac Red
short_description: Mathematical precision in motion: Double Ikat saree where both warp and weft yarns are resist-dyed before weaving.
detailed_story: Double Ikat is among the rarest textile arts on earth. The Gajam family calculated every millimetre of yarn tension before submerging bundles into herbal and eco dyes. When mounted on the pit loom, the intersection of warp and weft forms hazy, mesmerizing diamond stepped chevrons. The fabric carries a luxurious tactile texture and lustrous patina.
care_instructions: Dry clean recommended for silk longevity; keep wrapped in dark muslin.

title: Wild Forest Tussar Silk Sambalpuri Stole with Shankha & Tree of Life
weft_yarn: Hand-reeled Tussar Silk with Natural Slub
short_description: Textured wild Tussar silk stole carrying ancient tribal Ikat bandha motifs of the conch shell and cosmic tree.
detailed_story: Harvested ethically after the Tussar silkworm completes metamorphosis, this non-violent (Ahimsa) silk is reeled by tribal women and handwoven by Jagabandhu Meher in Barpali. The distinctive golden textured slub breathes in heat and retains cozy warmth in winter.
care_instructions: Dry clean or gentle cold shampoo wash; never wring wild silk.

title: Maheshwari Handspun Cotton-Silk Saree with Reversible Narmada Leher Border
color: Moss Green body with Terracotta Reversible Bugdi Border
dye_type: Indigo, Marigold and Henna leaf extracts
short_description: Graceful Maheshwari saree featuring the unique reversible border inspired by river waves and stone carvings of Ahilya Fort.
detailed_story: Rukmani Devi captures the gentle ripples of the holy Narmada in this drape. The iconic reversible border means the saree can be draped either way without showing an unsightly reverse seam. The cotton weft ensures cooling drape all day, while silk warp provides a festive luster.
care_instructions: Gentle hand wash with mild soap or dry clean. Iron damp on reverse.

title: Handwoven Chanderi Tissue Stole in Liquid Silver & Gold Zari
dye_type: Natural Bleached Silk with Metallic Luster
short_description: Glistening tissue stole woven from ultra-fine silk warp and pure zari weft for weddings and regal evening celebrations.
detailed_story: Chanderi tissue involves weaving high-luster silk threads tightly with shimmering zari yarn to create a molten metal visual effect. Despite its luminous gleam, it remains remarkably lightweight and supple around shoulders.

title: Artisanal Handwoven Pochampally Cotton Yardage (Unstitched Fabric)
color: Indigo Blue, Brick Red & Natural Off-White
short_description: Pure breathable cotton Ikat yardage with geometric bird & temple border motifs for bespoke kurtas, shirts and summer dresses.
detailed_story: Designed for conscious tailors and slow-fashion enthusiasts, this yardage comes directly from the master weavers of Bhoodan Pochampally. Every meter showcases slight natural irregularities in dye alignment that affirm authentic handloom mastery.
care_instructions: Cold gentle machine wash with like colors; do not soak for prolonged periods.
